notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Thank you all for playing the game!
The following fixes have been made
[olist]
[*]Bug : Fixed a bug in which the score displayed in the lower right corner of the screen during solo play was not the total score, but the increase in the score earned.
[*]Other minor fixes
[/olist]

Please continue to play "Hororo Meguru's BING!! Ball" in the future!

notes.title: BugFix
notes.notes:

[/list]
